sources.entry: updates2mqtt | Monitors running Docker containers for image updates, publishes to MQTT and integrates with Home Assistant

summary.one_liner: updates2mqtt is a Python service that checks running Docker containers for newer image versions, publishes the results to MQTT, and integrates with Home Assistant auto-discovery.
summary.what_it_does: It periodically checks registries for new versions of Docker images used by running containers, using either the v1 Docker APIs or the OCI v2 API. Version info is published to MQTT, with Home Assistant auto-discovery so updates appear alongside Home Assistant's own components. Updates can be triggered from the Home Assistant update dialog, or applied automatically per container via the UPD2MQTT_UPDATE setting (Auto, Passive or Silent). Local builds can be updated by pulling a git repo and running docker compose build, and Portainer and Docker Compose stacks are supported for restart. It can optionally remove old images after a container is recreated, and publishes an optional heartbeat payload. A command line tool can analyse a single container or fetch manifests, tags and blobs from remote registries.
use_cases: get notified in Home Assistant when Docker images have updates
automatically update Docker containers on a schedule
trigger container updates from the Home Assistant update dialog
monitor Docker image versions via MQTT
rebuild local Docker Compose images from a git repo
inspect remote container registry tags and manifests
how_to_run: docker run -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -e MQTT_USER=user1 -e MQTT_PASS=user1 -e MQTT_HOST=192.168.1.5 ghcr.io/rhizomatics/updates2mqtt:latest
export MQTT_HOST=192.168.1.1;export MQTT_USER=user1;export MQTT_PASS=user1;uv run --with updates2mqtt python -m updates2mqtt
notable: Home Assistant MQTT auto-discovery, with release notes and icons shown in the HA update dialog
Per-container automated updates via UPD2MQTT_UPDATE labels or environment variables
Local build support: git pull followed by docker compose build and up
Adaptive registry handling for GitHub, GitLab, Codeberg, Quay, LinuxServer, Microsoft MCR and Docker Hub
Optional removal of superseded images that no other container uses
caveats: Only Docker containers are supported at present; apt and other ecosystems are planned but not available
Needs access to the Docker socket (/var/run/docker.sock) and an MQTT broker
Healthcheck script depends on the mosquitto-clients package and MQTT settings being present in the container
keywords: notify me when a container has a new version
update docker containers from home automation
